## architecture


# Architecture

## Components
- **Menu bar app** (SwiftPM executable `AgentBoard`, bundle `co.tomac.agentboard`, LSUIElement). evidence: Package.swift, build.sh
  - `AgentBoardApp.swift`: entry and the `Board` observable model (polls the flag, caffeinate, servers).
  - `Bar.swift`: the one NSStatusItem pill and its pixel art; `Panel.swift`: the glass panel tiles.
- **Scripts** in `bin/`: `boardctl` (flip hands off), `boardd` (enforcer loop), `servers` (localhost listeners as TSV). evidence: bin/
- **Claude Code hook** `hooks/hands-off-guard.sh` (PreToolUse on Bash). evidence: install.sh
- **LaunchAgents** `launchd/*.plist`, templated with `@ROOT@`/`@HOME@` by install.sh. evidence: install.sh
- `swiftbar/`: the original SwiftBar plugins; the caffeinate tile still calls `swiftbar/caffeinate/caffeinate.5s.sh`. evidence: AgentBoardApp.swift#caffeinate

## Data flow: hands off
- The panel and `boardctl` only write or remove `~/.agent-board/hands-off`; `boardd` and the hook enforce. [IMPORTANT] Keep enforcement out of the UI.
- Other tools read the flag (Agents Mission Control stays silent while it exists). evidence: README.md

## State on disk
- `~/.agent-board/hands-off`; logs `~/Library/Logs/boardd.log`. Info.plist key `BoardRoot` points the app at the checkout (scripts run live from the repo). evidence: build.sh, AgentBoardApp.swift

## conventions


# Conventions

- Imperative commit subjects, often prefixed with the area and a colon; body explains why. evidence: history of tomacco/agents-mission-control
- Swift 5.10 tools, macOS 26+, SwiftUI with an AppKit status item; no Xcode project. evidence: Package.swift
- Shell scripts are **zsh** (`#!/bin/zsh`, `${0:A:h}` idioms), never bash. evidence: bin/*, tests/*, build.sh
- Comments explain why, one or two lines above the code. evidence: Sources/*.swift
- Menu bar art is pixel grids drawn live in SwiftUI `Canvas` (no PNG templates), so it follows light and dark. evidence: Bar.swift#Art

## workflows


# Workflows

- `./build.sh` → `build/AgentBoard.app` (Developer ID when available, ad hoc otherwise). evidence: build.sh
- `./install.sh` (idempotent): build, copy to `~/Applications`, (re)load both LaunchAgents, register the hook (`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` picks another config). `./uninstall.sh` removes all of it. evidence: install.sh, uninstall.sh
- [IMPORTANT] install.sh does not restart a running app: quit it and `open -a ~/Applications/AgentBoard.app`. evidence: install.sh
- `zsh tests/test-hands-off.sh` (18 checks, private flag, safe anytime). evidence: tests/test-hands-off.sh
- Preview: `build/AgentBoard.app/Contents/MacOS/AgentBoard --preview` prints a window number for `screencapture -o -l <n>`. evidence: Bar.swift
- Release: bump `CFBundleShortVersionString` in build.sh, add a CHANGELOG.md entry, tag `vX.Y.Z`, GitHub release. evidence: CHANGELOG.md
- Knowledge: `bash scripts/check-freshness.sh` (pre-commit and CI); after editing `.distill/`, run `bash scripts/render-adapters.sh`. evidence: scripts/

## gotchas


# Gotchas

- [IMPORTANT] Never click the menu bar or post synthetic input to test the UI: a person may be at the keyboard. Use `--preview`. evidence: AGENTS.md
- [IMPORTANT] If `bin/boardctl status` says hands off is on, do not speak, play sounds or drive input, and never turn it off yourself. evidence: AGENTS.md, hooks/hands-off-guard.sh
- Running the tests with `bash` fails (`A: unbound variable`): they are zsh. evidence: tests/*.sh shebang
- A Bash command whose text contains `pkill` or `quit app` (even inside a heredoc) trips the app-quit guard some sessions run. Write such scripts with the file editor. evidence: 2026-10-15 split
- A program posting mouse events under a name outside the block list is not stopped (backlog task-1). evidence: bin/boardd#BLOCK

## glossary


# Glossary

- **Hands off**: switch that forbids agents to speak, play sounds or drive mouse and keyboard; the file `~/.agent-board/hands-off`. evidence: README.md
- **Pill**: the single menu bar status item (Clawd, cup, rack). evidence: README.md
- **Clawd**: the pixel mascot in the pill. evidence: Bar.swift#Art
- **boardd**: the enforcer LaunchAgent that kills blocked processes while hands off is on. evidence: bin/boardd
